values.string:
=You are a support ticket classifier. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly four fields:
- category: one of Technical, Billing, Account, Feature Request, General
- priority: one of high, medium, low
- next_action: a short action sentence (max 10 words)
- assigned_team: one of Engineering, Billing, Customer Success, Product, General Support

No explanation. No markdown. Raw JSON only.

Issue: {{ $json.issue }}

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_id, user_email, issue, category, priority, next_action, assigned_team, status, thread_id) VALUES ('{{ $json.ticket_id }}', '{{ $json.user_email }}', '{{ $json.issue }}', '{{ $json.category }}', '{{ $json.priority }}', '{{ $json.next_action }}', '{{ $json.assigned_team }}', CASE WHEN '{{ $json.priority }}' = 'high' THEN 'urgent' ELSE 'open' END, '{{ $json.thread_id }}') RETURNING ticket_id, user_email, category, priority, status, next_action, assigned_team

parameters.subject: =[HIGH PRIORITY] Ticket {{ $json.ticket_id }} — Immediate Action Required
=Ticket {{ $json.ticket_id }} Received — We're On It
=Ticket {{ $json.ticket_id }} Logged
